_readme: Copy this file to my_area.json, set a name and bbox, and run bash quickstart.sh <name>. The bbox is [west, south, east, north] in WGS84 degrees. Keep it small on a first run: ~0.005 x 0.005 degrees (~400 x 550 m) is a few dozen buildings. Null layer fields use a configured survey only when it fully covers the bbox; otherwise set the custom survey's dsm_layer and the available imagery/reference-imagery and point-cloud fields. A pointcloud_bulk_url requires lidar_tile_index_layer and pointcloud_tile_year; use null when raw point cloud is unavailable. Find LINZ layer IDs at data.linz.govt.nz and public point-cloud datasets at opentopography.org. Building outlines are national.
name: my_test_area
